notes: The reference performance run: the whole seventeen-node chain completed under the cockpit driver, with every one of its seven gates answered from a file. The frozen workflow: block carries the shipped definition's graph hash and node_summaries sits beside it, one entry per node. The workflow's own context block is performance_context - the bottleneck counts, the priority split, the resolved-clarifications flag and the four phase summaries keyed by this workflow's own names, each carrying the node it came from - and there is no second context block, because a run whose state carries two is a run two interpreters wrote. The profiling question is recorded as defaulted on the bottleneck analysis, which is what a run under a non-terminal driver writes when nobody can drop files into the profiling directory. Artifacts keep the A4 layout, and only the two files the fixture actually carries are listed on a summary: implementation/work-log.md, which is on the A5 exempt list and carries no summary block, and verification/implementation-verification.md, which is A5-registered and opens with one. Every other node's artifacts list is empty rather than pointing at a file that is not here. Synthetic rather than sampled: the run it describes is the shape an engine run of this workflow writes, built to the same schemas the sampled runs are held to, with no absolute path belonging to anyone.
